text:
Cole Perfetti has gone eight games without a goal, most of them during Winnipeg's eight-game winless run, and it is the least worrying drought on the team. Those eight games came with 3.5 expected goals, and he has 51 shots on the season. He has 6 goals and 12 points in 17 games, 7.52 expected goals of his own. The finishing is a little behind; the process is ahead of where it has ever been.

The bigger story is the job. He is playing 18:30 a night, up from 15:37, and he is on the ice for 91 percent of Winnipeg's power play, up from half of it. Winnipeg wins his minutes at 5v5 by 7 points of expected goal share over when he sits. Evolving-Hockey liked his defense last season (95th percentile at suppressing chances), which is part of why the coaches trust him with more.

He is 24 and this is the season the Jets have been waiting for. When the goals come, they may come in a bunch.
headline: Perfetti is due, and he's earned the role
